text:
This page supports your daily coordination work at the Companion Animal Travel Desk by showing how to handle two critical control points quickly and correctly. These steps matter because Aurelia Skyways coordinates care from booking through pickup, and calm, consistent actions protect both travelers and pets like Ellie.

As you manage companion animal travel, keep the workflow moving: confirm the booking details, verify the pet travel requirements, ensure the pickup contact is correct, and log every meaningful interaction. When something deviates from plan, do not wait for another handoff; use the escalation path designed for that moment so the right team can intervene without delay. Document what you see and what you are told, keeping language factual and easy to audit.

For arrival pickup, escalate using EX-417 when you need an immediate override on the pickup coordination.

For incident reporting, route the case for incident reporting to the Claim Adjudicator as the reviewing role once the facts are captured.

If Mariam Nguyen and Sara Torres are traveling with their companion animals, treat their timelines and comfort as part of the operational record. Communicate in clear, short sentences, confirm the next action before ending each interaction, and keep the traveler informed about what you have completed and what is queued next.

When you close a file, verify that the pickup notes and incident notes are complete, legible, and placed in the correct place in the travel record. Remember to escalate fast, document cleanly, and keep all communications consistent.
